title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics priority sampling and sampling policy improvements
author: Asha Patel
ci_status: pass (build, unit, lint) - integration test flaky once and retried
description:
Motivation: Reduce noise and improve signal quality from automated diagnostics surfaced to on-call engineers by introducing priority-aware sampling rules and better sampling policy configuration. High-throughput services were generating large numbers of low-value diagnostics which buried high-priority signals and increased SLO noise and storage costs.

What this PR does: Adds configurable priority-based sampling to the oncall diagnostics pipeline, including a policy definition format, evaluation engine, and feature flag rollout. Key behaviors: 1) diagnostics now carry a priority label (low/medium/high) computed from existing heuristics + new weight rules; 2) sampling policy supports per-priority target rates and burst windows; 3) sampled diagnostics include sampling metadata so downstream tools can account for sampling when computing counts/alerts; 4) feature-flag gated rollout with default conservative config.

Files changed: small, focused changes in the diagnostics pipeline and one docs + tests. Backwards compatibility: existing diagnostics without priority remain supported (default medium). No breaking changes.

How to test: See testing_instructions below. Unit and integration tests added. CI noted a flaky integration test which was retried and passed; re-run logs included.

Rollout plan: deploy behind feature flag; enable in beta tenant group for 48h; monitor diagnostics volume and oncall alerts; then full rollout.

Related: ENG-1821 (diagnostics quality), ENG-1844 (storage cost reductions), SUP-4472 (support case referencing noisy diagnostics).

Author (Asha Patel): Addressed in docs and sampling metadata now includes original_timestamp and sampling_reason fields.

Devon Lee: Approved - thanks for addressing comments.
release_notes: Add configurable priority-based sampling for oncall diagnostics; default conservative policy; feature-flag rollout. Improves signal-to-noise ratio and reduces storage/alert noise.
testing_instructions: Run unit tests: make test-pkg=./pkg/diagnostics. Integration: make integration-test with PIPELINE_MOCK=true. To exercise sampling behavior locally: start incident-bot with feature flag ENABLE_PRIORITY_SAMPLING=true and load test fixture test/fixtures/sampling_policy.json via ./scripts/load-policy.sh; verify logs show sampling decisions and sampled_count metrics. Observe metrics: diagnostics.sampled{priority="high"} and diagnostics.sample_rate_applied.
